patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Reply.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Reply.io's shape. Choose Reply.io only if your buying job matches “AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS,” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Ocean.io leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Reply.io leans sales-engagement, email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Reply.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline.; Reply.io is AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS, and WhatsApp with built-in B2B data..
- Workflow coverage skew: Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Reply.io-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Reply.io — none listed.

Limitations — Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools; Reply.io: —.

Poor-fit cases: Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Avoid Ocean.io if you actually need Reply.io's motion (AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, c) · Avoid Reply.io if you actually need Ocean.io's motion (Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
